title: Compatible geometric compactifications of a composable pair
statement: Let $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{g}Z$ be separated finite-type morphisms of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $d=(i:Y\hookrightarrow\overline Y,\overline g:\overline Y\to Z)$ be a compactification of $g$ [def-nagata-compactification]. There exists a compactification $e=(a:X\hookrightarrow\overline X,p:\overline X\to\overline Y)$ of $i\circ f$. Put $U=\overline X\times_{\overline Y}Y$, with projections $b:U\to\overline X$ and $p_Y:U\to Y$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. There is a quasi-compact open immersion $c:X\hookrightarrow U$ with $b\circ c=a$ and $p_Y\circ c=f$. The morphism $b$ is a quasi-compact open immersion and $p_Y$ is proper. Both $(c,p_Y)$ and $(a,\overline g\circ p)$ are compactifications, of $f$ and $g\circ f$ respectively. The square $p\circ b=i\circ p_Y$ is Cartesian.
